version_item.title: 60 题与 140 题：按作答范围和可用时间选择
version_item.body:
60 题标准版用于快速建立六维职业兴趣轮廓；140 题版会让你分别考虑活动、环境与角色偏好，再按既有权重汇总为六维结果。两版都提供 RIASEC 六维分布与三字代码，题目更多不自动代表更准确。

选择你能专注完成的版本即可。兴趣分反映你更愿意投入哪些活动，不等于能力水平、岗位胜任力或确定性的职业匹配率。

version_item.title: 60 or 140 questions: choose by scope and available time
version_item.body:
The 60-question standard form gives you a focused six-interest profile. The 140-question form asks about activities, environments, and roles before combining them into the same six RIASEC dimensions. Both provide six scores and a three-letter code; more questions do not by themselves establish greater accuracy.

Choose the form you can complete attentively. Interest scores describe activities you prefer, not ability, job competence, or a guaranteed career match.
